create_factor_group: create a FactorGroup to represent a group of Factors in a factor graph with variables and log potentials
build_single_factor_group: build a SingleFactorGroup containing exactly one factor with its variables and log potentials
compile_factor_group_wiring: compile wiring for a FactorGroup given a mapping of variables to their global starting indices
query_factor_group: query an individual factor in a FactorGroup by providing the set of connected variables
flatten_factor_group_data: flatten structured data into a flat array for internal use in a FactorGroup
